strings.name: Mia Couto
strings.summary: Raised in Mozambique, Couto worked in journalism before combining biology and literature. Oral traditions, local vocabulary and inventive Portuguese shape his writing about war, memory and daily life. Sleepwalking Land and the Sands of the Emperor trilogy place individual lives within colonial and post-independence history. His work has received Camões, Neustadt and PEN honors.
